description.zh: 密钥名称，只支持十六进制字符，小写会自动转换为大写，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-128或者GCM-AES-XPN-128时，长度要求为32个十六进制字符，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-256或者GCM-AES-XPN-256时，长度要求为64个十六进制字符
description.en: The key name. Only hexadecimal characters are supported. Lowercase characters are automatically converted to uppercase. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, the length must be 32 hexadecimal characters. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, the length must be 64 hexadecimal characters.

description.en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~448570~~) operation to query region IDs.

descriptions.zh:
- 取消关联当前处于 Associated 状态的密钥，会自动关联最近生效的密钥
- 取消关联当前处于 Disassociated 状态的密钥，会对密钥进行删除
descriptions.en:
- If you dissociate a key that is in the Associated state, the most recently activated key is automatically associated.
- If you dissociate a key that is in the Disassociated state, the key is deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc disassociate-mac-sec-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-bp1hp0wr072f60000 --ckn 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF --region cn-hangzhou
